MVM uses a two-step process, first involving Chk2 activation, CDC25A proteasome-mediated degradation, and Chk1 activation to halt cell cycle progression in S-phase and then, in a second step, cyclin B1 degradation to prevent infected cells from entering mitosis and allowing for continued viral replication.
